legal.governanceLeft: AutoNexa Canada Inc. • National Wholesale Platform
legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy outlines how AutoNexa Canada collects, uses, protects, and manages your personal vehicle data in strict compliance with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), Quebec Law 25, and provincial motor vehicle regulatory councils.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the AutoNexa Canada digital marketplace, auction terminal, and related vehicle wholesale trade-in services.

seller.dashboardSubtitle: Private vehicle inventory & real-time sealed dealer auction telemetry across vetted Canadian dealer networks.
seller.searchPlaceholder: Search your listings by VIN, make, model or location...
seller.notificationsSubtitle: Live updates on dealer bids, moderation approvals, identity checks, and vehicle settlements.

dealer.inventorySubtitle: Active 24-hour sealed auctions from verified private sellers across Ontario & Quebec.
dealer.subscriptionSubtitle: All subscription fees are billed in CAD via Stripe with zero per-vehicle buyer premiums.
dealer.billingSubtitle: Manage your monthly sealed-bid quota, inspect subscription status, and download persisted CAD invoices.
dealer.registerSubtitle: Verify provincial dealership licensing to participate in live sealed-bid wholesale auctions.

admin.moderationSubtitle: Review vehicle odometer clarity, NHTSA decoded specs, title liens, and condition disclosures before launching 24h dealer auctions.
admin.dealersSubtitle: Validate commercial dealership credentials against Canadian provincial registries (OMVIC, AMVIC, VSA, OPC) and enforce BR-14 license suspensions.
admin.auctionsSubtitle: Real-time wholesale exchange supervision, countdown extensions, instant unsealing overrides, statutory compliance halts, and sealed-bid surveillance.
admin.disputesSubtitle: Review condition discrepancies, hoist inspection damage claims, and integer-cent settlement adjustments between Canadian sellers and verified dealerships.
admin.analyticsSubtitle: Live Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), sealed-bid velocity, regional quota distribution, and verifiable PostgreSQL settlement feeds.
admin.auditSubtitle: Tamper-evident, cryptographically chained chronological ledger verified via PostgreSQL SHA-256 trigger hashing and append-only mutation protection.
